title: Ask HN: Have you stopped underestimating AI yet?
excerpt: It’s not about what the AI can do, it’s about your ability as a human to keep up with the details so you can make effective decisions. You the human are ultimately responsible.
content_html:
It’s not about what the AI can do, it’s about your ability as a human to keep up with the details so you can make effective decisions. You the human are ultimately responsible.

Because where dangers lie is when you lose track of that one tiny important thing that turns out to really really matter.

The AI won’t get fired, you will.
